name: Fatehold Charm
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Draw a card. Empower Jace 2.
• Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.
• Creatures you control get +1/+2 until end of turn.

needs.what: a keyword action 'Empower <name> N' that empowers the named planeswalker (Jace) by N, per its Multiverse Reforged rules (e.g. adding loyalty to / advancing a named planeswalker you control or in your command zone)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's reference has no empower op, keyword or value; add_counters with loyalty would need a selector by planeswalker name and still would not match empower's own rules for when no such Jace is present
